summary: A Google DeepMind employee describes a change making visible watermarks on AI-generated images optional while keeping invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata for provenance detection via Gemini or Search.

practices.reason: Describes a provenance/detection mechanism (invisible watermark plus C2PA metadata checkable via Gemini or Search) relevant to trust and verification workflows.
practices.quote: invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata are still being used for transparency. So you can still use Gemini or Search to see if an image was AI-generated.
